subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “A scientist told students that long records are extremely valuable.”?
options: Technology often makes people think about safety, but it can also help people see good actions.
They help researchers see changes over time.
The letter helped students see continuity across time.
Sometimes usefulness changes with time, but it does not always disappear.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Technology often makes people think about safety, but it can also help people see good actions.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「A scientist told students that long records are extremely valuable. They help researchers see changes over time.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「The letter helped students see continuity across time.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Sometimes usefulness changes with time, but it does not always disappear.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「A scientist told students that long records are extremely valuable. They help researchers see changes over time.」，答案為「They help researchers see changes over time.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「They help researchers see changes over time.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
